NEVER CLIMBED BEFORE?

You can just
be new at it.

Everybody is working on something they cannot do yet. You do not need to arrive strong, know the language, or bring a friend who climbs. Wear clothes you can move in and leave time for a proper introduction.

Our sample first visit includes entry, shoe hire and a staff safety brief. Bouldering involves falls and risk of injury, even onto mats. Follow the actual gym’s rules, supervision requirements and in-person instruction.

YOUR FIRST HOUR

Here is what
actually happens.

MINUTE 0

Arriving.

Meet the team. Discuss the participation form, shoe hire and anything you need to ask.

MINUTE 10

The brief.

A staff member explains the wall, landing areas and rules. This page is not a substitute for that instruction.

MINUTE 25

The easy wall.

Ask which problems suit a first visit. Start at your own pace and take breaks.

MINUTE 40

Another go.

Falling is part of bouldering, but mats do not remove the risk. Ask the team whenever you are unsure.

THE COLOURS ARE A STARTING POINT

Grades.
Not a verdict.

Big holds and an obvious path. Ask the team for a good first problem.
